chunk.content: Scenario 3.3.2 Kịch bản thực thi PowerShell nghi vấn. Description: Reviewable MSHTA-PowerShell scenario in which cmd.exe launches mshta.exe and mshta.exe launches powershell.exe with -noexit -command Get-Service sysmon. Process creation records establish the launch command, not successful cmdlet completion or a finalized attack determination. Analysis status: draft_reviewable. Observed behavior: PowerShell was launched with -noexit -command Get-Service sysmon. cmd.exe launched mshta.exe with an inline vbscript:Execute command. mshta.exe launched PowerShell.

scope_limitations: This ground truth scope covers only the two reviewed behavior and evidence groups.
The two Sysmon observations carry upstream timestamp_conflict review issues.
A full-dataset negative scan has not been performed, so absence claims cannot be made across the full scope.
MITRE assessments remain candidates and require human review.
Process-creation telemetry does not establish successful cmdlet completion, output, or the Sysmon service state.
Canonical timestamps follow TimeCreated; Sysmon UtcTime differs by about four hours and its timezone is unresolved.

The file also contains conhost creation, event-log clearing and temporary-file deletion telemetry outside this two-group core. These must not be described as globally absent or automatically classified as a destructive payload.
CTI facts are publisher-reported external context. They do not establish local host compromise, campaign attribution, HTTP completion or confirmed C2.
